goal: Accessibility audits across media in frontend/src/components/.
summary: Audited, verified, and enforced full accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.2 AA) across all media components in frontend/src/components/. Verified full keyboard navigation, screen reader announcements (aria-live polite/assertive, role landmarks), synchronized captions/subtitles, high-contrast support (contrast-more variants, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1), and 2D text alternatives. Enforced strict negative abuse protections preventing historical learning content from being locked exclusively behind 3D, AR, or sound without accessible equivalents.
invariants_enforced: FULL_KEYBOARD_NAVIGATION: All interactive media controls (FloatingAudioPlayer, SketchfabExhibit, Panorama360, VirtualTours, CaptionsFeed) provide full keyboard navigation, tabIndex, focus-visible outlines, and shortcut keys (Space, M, T, Escape).

ARIA_LIVE_SCREEN_READER_ANNOUNCEMENTS: Live region announcements with aria-live='polite', role='status' or role='log', and descriptive aria-labels announce playback state, view changes, and transcript loading.

SYNCHRONIZED_CAPTIONS_AND_SUBTITLES: 100% transcript and timed cue coverage across all 16 Imperial Audio Guides, and auto-scrolling live caption feed (CaptionsFeed) with role='log' and aria-atomic='false'.

HIGH_CONTRAST_SUPPORT: Contrast ratios exceed WCAG 2.2 AA thresholds (>= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3.0:1 for UI elements), accompanied by explicit contrast-more:border-2 and contrast-more:border-foreground styles.

EQUIVALENT_2D_ALTERNATIVES: All 9 Cửu Đỉnh 3D manifests link to 2D rubbing archives (ban-duc-noi/) and UrnAccessibleFallback tables; Sketchfab 3D exhibits provide direct toggle to high-resolution photographic and archival 2D dossiers; VR tours provide 2D still images and text alternatives.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_EXCLUSIVE_MEDIA_LOCK_DEFENSE: Validation fails closed with ExclusiveMediaLockError if any historical learning content is locked exclusively behind 3D, AR, or sound without an accessible 2D or text equivalent.

changes.description: Added role='log', aria-live='polite', aria-atomic='false', aria-relevant='additions text', aria-label='Phụ đề đối thoại trực tiếp', tabIndex={0} for keyboard navigation/scrolling, empty role='status', and high-contrast support.

Added accessible 2D alternative mode toggle button ('Xem bản chụp 2D & Tư liệu thay thế'), screen reader announcement live region (aria-live='polite'), Escape key listener to dismiss 3D and free GPU memory, focus-visible indicators, and high-contrast border styling.
Added onReturnTo3D callback prop and button ('Xem mô hình 3D') allowing seamless return to interactive 3D, enhanced keyboard accessibility, and added contrast-more:border-2 high-contrast styling.
Added screen reader live region announcement upon urn selection, contrast-more high-contrast borders, accessible select label, and full 18-relief table navigation.
Added screen reader live region announcement on mode toggles (3D interactive vs 2D still accessible view), contrast-more high-contrast borders, and keyboard accessible controls.
Added role='tablist' and role='tab' semantics with aria-selected and keyboard navigation across panorama scene buttons, plus high-contrast styling.
Added role='tablist' and role='tab' semantics, accessible 2D textual description toggle and content for each tour, screen reader live region announcements, and high-contrast styling.

Added ARIA live status announcer for playback state changes, keyboard shortcuts (Space=play/pause, M=mute, T=transcript), aria-keyshortcuts, aria-expanded/aria-controls on transcript drawer button, and high-contrast styles.
Added id='audio-transcript-drawer', role='dialog', aria-label, and high-contrast styling to SheetContent.
Added aria-label and aria-pressed attributes to 360/2D mode toggle buttons, and contrast-more high-contrast styles.
Created Playwright E2E accessibility audit test suite covering landmarks, skip links, 2D fallbacks, and negative abuse.

Implemented core backend media accessibility audit service: audits 3D manifests, Sketchfab models, audio guides, VR360 tours, frontend component source contracts, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios, and enforces negative abuse protections against exclusive media locking.

Created comprehensive 11-test suite covering 3D 2D-fallbacks, audio guide transcript coverage, VR 2D alternatives, component contracts, negative abuse tests (failing on locked content), contrast math, and database parity.
